title: VERHallu: Evaluating and Mitigating Event Relation Hallucination in Video Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing and evaluating multiple-choice question answering and counterfactual tasks where specific candidate answers are designed using pure language priors (based only on the question) to test if models rely on text over actual visual evidence.

Constructing and evaluating multiple-choice question answering tasks featuring candidate answers based on vision-language priors (spurious multimodal correlations) to assess if models rely on superficial cues rather than genuine event relation reasoning.
